label: Industrial / manufacturing
description: A manufacturing or process plant: production lines and process units, a DCS/SCADA control room, safety systems, hazardous materials, a plant emergency response team and the surrounding community.

vocabulary.facility: the plant (process units, lines, tank farm, control room)
vocabulary.public: the surrounding community and the plant workforce
vocabulary.frontline: shift supervisors, board operators, outside operators, maintenance technicians, safety officers, security guards
vocabulary.operationsCenter: the plant control room and the emergency response center

roles.name: Plant Manager (Incident Commander)
roles.description: Owns the plant, production and the big decisions.

roles.name: Shift Supervisor (Operations Section Chief)
roles.description: Owns the process, the board operators and the field crews.

roles.name: OT / IT Security Manager (Technical Lead)
roles.description: Owns the control network, the DCS and the investigation.

roles.name: EHS Manager (Safety Officer)
roles.description: Owns safety, environmental releases and regulator reporting.

roles.name: Community Relations Manager (PIO)
roles.description: Owns community messaging, social media and the press.

outsideParties: the local fire department and HAZMAT team
EPA and the state environmental agency
the DCS vendor and system integrator
mediaChannels: a neighbor's Facebook post with a photo of the flare
a community alert group on Nextdoor

sceneAnchors.public: a plant visitor lobby: a security desk, a turnstile, a rack of hard hats and visitor badges, fluorescent light
sceneAnchors.control: inside a process plant control room: operators at a curved DCS console, dark screens, hard hats on a rack, dim lighting
sceneAnchors.exterior: an outdoor process unit: pipe racks, storage tanks, steel stairs, a flare stack, a worker in flame-resistant coveralls and a hard hat, overcast daylight

noiseExamples: a badge reader slow at the turnstile
a contractor without a hot-work permit
a printer jam in the control room
pressureExamples: a neighbor's photo of the flare with a scary caption
a rumor of a chemical release on Nextdoor

the fire chief asking whether to evacuate the neighborhood
corporate asking for a production estimate
